The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] was a '''colleague''' of [[Murl (Human)|Murl]] at the [[Odionate]] [[Odionate cloister|cloister]] on [[Vanahame]] in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]]. He and Murl were responsible for maintaining the level of artificial light within the Cloister chambers, which housed thousands of children imprisoned in bubble capsules. During the [[Battle of Vanahame]], he and Murl were ordered to switch off all the lights in the Cloister, plunging into pitch darkness and driving the children into a state of fear and panic.

These negative emotions allowed [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Odion]] to activate the [[Helm of Ieldis]], an ancient [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] capable of driving sentient beings into a homicidal frenzy. Odion intended to bring a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] apocalypse but was thwarted by a redeemed [[Beld Yulan]] who killed Murl's colleague and forced Murl to switch back on the lights and free the children, ending the Helm's killing frenzy and causing to overload and kill Odion.
